controls: Actual full ordered histories, repeated edge positions, empty/reflexive prefix and strictly longer nonprefix.
Different actual cycle histories with same endpoint/length compare false both ways; root and role mismatches reject.
Both documents independently validated; stale source/taxonomy bytes, relation content/endpoints/indices/joins, role/direction/authority fields and bounded hostile JSON rejected.
CLI binds separate trace file identities, rechecks both inputs/raw taxonomy/current ref; retained explicit snapshot accepted.
limits: Bounded Python operational controls only. Synthetic method/edge fixtures never written to taxonomy; duplicate-edge guard unchanged. No Lean/runtime graph refinement, source snapshot/taxonomy containment, hash injectivity, full filesystem transaction theorem, proof or permission authority. Correlated source review not independent validation.
